baseline: Unchanged V2.4.3 eligible decisions; signal and execution constraints preserved

variable.name: strategy_volume_acceleration
variable.reason: Natural ratio-to-baseline comparison, not a fitted threshold

population: All immutable forward shadow decisions after registration, not only executed or settled signals; explicit epoch/model/version matching required
outcomeScope: Formal matched execution cohort diagnostics only until rejected/unfilled candidate paths and comparable execution costs are verifiable
historicalDataPolicy: No backfill from mutable signals/shadow rows; no holdout/sealed data; no old extrema as executable outcomes
missingPolicy: Unknown fields remain missing; unfilled/open/censored outcomes are not zero; invalid hashes and future timestamps excluded with reasons

review.checkpointPurpose: Coverage, execution exceptions and descriptive evidence only; not statistical promotion
review.inference: Pre-register a fixed evaluation window and event/time-block uncertainty method before claiming superiority; account for overlapping positions, repeated symbols and all attempted hypotheses
review.pass: Positive net expectancy and improvement on untouched time windows, acceptable downside and cost stress; no automatic pass from sample count, PF or win rate alone
review.stop: Ambiguous provenance, missing executable paths or unresolved execution contamination blocks causal PnL comparison, not ordinary descriptive reporting

otherHypotheses.name: snapshot_age
otherHypotheses.note: Separate snapshot age from candle-close age and unknown upstream receive time

otherHypotheses.name: directional_boundary_distance
otherHypotheses.note: Do not substitute radar nearestBoundaryAtr or fit a cutoff on the seven discovery trades
